name: delivery-vitrine-b
prompt:
Use case: app-interface-mockup. Produce a pixel-crisp, high-fidelity mobile website composition for the real Russian takeaway menu of restaurant «Гурман», Tyumen. This is a UI screenshot, not a poster, not a mood board, not a physical phone mockup. Portrait frame proportional to a 390 x 844 CSS-pixel browser viewport, rendered at high resolution. The entire canvas is the webpage, edge-to-edge; do not add a device, desktop surround, browser chrome, variant label or presentation board.

DESIGN WORLD FIXED ACROSS VARIANTS: a calm contemporary prepared-food counter display translated into functional digital catalog geometry. Serious, confident, elegant through restraint, ordinary and trustworthy rather than luxury. White #FFFFFF reading surface, very pale neutral gray #F0F1F2 photo placeholders, charcoal #24272B primary text, secondary text #555B63, light gray #D9DDE1 separators, deep graphite #303840 primary phone action. One excellent contemporary humanist sans-serif with clear Cyrillic, like a highly refined native mobile catalog; no serif, no monospace, no ornamental lettering. Large readable 19px-equivalent body, 23px dish names, 30px headings, 14px minimum captions. Every touch target at least 54px high. Left alignment; exceptionally disciplined spacing and numeric alignment. Flat matte planes, zero decorative shadows, zero blur or glass, zero gradients. Small 6-10px corners only on photo wells or touch controls. Realistic production-ready interface, not abstract wireframe.

CRITICAL IMAGE TRUTH: We have no verified individual dish photos yet. EVERY dish gets its own separate pale-gray rectangular empty photo well. Inside each well, show only a discreet simple camera-outline glyph and exact text "Фото блюда" and secondary "пока нет". These are deliberately finished empty states. Do not depict food, plates, takeaway containers, people or restaurant imagery anywhere. Do not invent a food image. The design must later suit unstyled phone snapshots of food in takeaway containers, so use uncomplicated uncropped rectangular image wells, not luxury framing, silhouettes or glamorous crops.

REAL CONTENT AND FUNCTION: restaurant "Гурман", page title "Меню на вынос", secondary context "Тюмень · Линейная, 66", link "PDF". Four navigation destinations use exact strings "Шашлыки", "Закуски", "Выпечка", "Сеты". Active section is "Шашлыки", section caption "11 блюд". First dish "Свиная шея" has two options, "200 г" with "300 ₽", and "1 кг" with "1 430 ₽". Second dish "Свиные рёбра" has the same two options. Third dish if visible "Куриное ассорти" has "200 г" with "260 ₽", and "1 кг" with "950 ₽". Persistent bottom phone action reads "Позвонить" and "21-75-65" on one graphite button, white text, 56px equivalent height. No cart, search, quantity steppers, add buttons, fake ratings, unsupported ingredients, sales text, delivery times, hours, discounts, badge, green dot or illustration. Russian text must be spelled correctly. All portions and prices must remain paired and visually unambiguous. No newspaper layout, editorial serif, cream, gold, burgundy, terracotta, bright colors or promotional hero.

COMPOSITION B — COMPARISON ROWS. At the top compact "Гурман" left and underlined "PDF" right, then 30px "Меню на вынос" and one small address line. Total intro about 145 CSS px. A flat horizontal navigation row shows all four category names, active "Шашлыки" bold with an underline. Then a compact section heading "Шашлыки" with "11 блюд". Below, use elegant full-width open product rows separated only by thin horizontal rules, never outer cards. Each row is 150–170 CSS px high. On the left a substantial 120px square neutral photo placeholder with camera glyph and "Фото блюда" / "пока нет"; on the right a 23px bold dish name and underneath a two-row portion-and-price table: "200 г" on the left / "300 ₽" on the right; "1 кг" on the left / "1 430 ₽" on the right. Table body is readable 19px and prices medium-bold. Row one "Свиная шея", row two "Свиные рёбра", row three "Куриное ассорти" with its true prices. All three rows should be substantially visible in the phone frame while preserving the readable sizes and sufficient spacing. No thumbnails smaller than 112px, no tiny text, no price chips. Show that a user can compare several dishes quickly and still see each one as an individual photograph. Bottom phone action as defined. Main focal moment: three clear individual food slots and perfectly aligned portion-price pairs in one glance; editorial decoration is completely absent.
approval: User selected B — compact comparison rows; relayed by parent agent in the current turn.
